title: Gemini in Google Docs

body.text: Gemini in Google Docs works as a writing assistant: the
'Help me write' feature creates content, improves sentences, and expands ideas
based on your instructions — great for starting a document or report.

example: "Help me write: an introduction for the Marketing team's Q2 performance report."

title: Adjust writing style with Gemini

body.text: adjust the writing tone — formal, casual, more concise, or more detailed
. Just select the text and tell Gemini to adjust it to the style you want.

example: "[Select text] Refine: make it formal, suitable for sending to executives."

question: What does the 'Help me write' feature in Google Docs do?

options.text: Helps create content, improve sentences, and expand ideas
Translate documents to a foreign language

question: To make text more formal, what should you do?

options.text: Select the text and ask Gemini to make it formal

question: What kind of work is Gemini in Google Docs good for?

options.text: Writing, editing, and refining content in a document

question: You're writing a report in Google Docs and want it more formal. What should you do?

options.text: Use Gemini in Docs to adjust the writing tone

question: What can Gemini in Google Docs help with?

options.text: Drafting, editing, and summarizing content in a document
Typing in place of a real keyboard
